title: Tile Strips
statement: A hallway is 2 units wide and n units long. It is covered with 2 × 1 tiles that can lie across or along the hallway. Return the number of different tilings modulo 1,000,000,007.

keyPoints: The last column is one tile across (from n − 1) or two tiles along (from n − 2)
Take the modulo at every addition

hints: Look at the right end of the hallway: how can it be covered?
Either one tile across, or two tiles along it side by side.
Same recurrence as the stairs; apply % 1,000,000,007 at each step.
